top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated (26 TAC §744.2653(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child had been given medication without the medication authorization signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Sanitize Table Tops, Furniture, Equipment (26 TAC §744.2507(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Toys are only being cleaned with soap and water; they are not being sanitized. This was corrected at inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children under 2 years old was observed watching television during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the gatherings during the investigation, it was determined concrete evidence exists to support that the school have not followed the instructions on the sanitizing solution.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A television was not anchored to the table it was sitting on.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.
